body.statement: For the nuisance-efficient exact-alpha rule \(\widehat G_m\) and every balanced sequence \(m=m(n)\) with \(m\to\infty\), \(N\to\infty\), and \(m/n\to0\), \[\sup_{\beta\in\mathcal K}\frac{\left|R_{n,m}(\widehat G_m,\beta)-R_n^{\mathrm{or}}(\beta)-A(\beta)m/n^2-B(\beta)/(nm)\right|}{m/n^2+1/(nm)}\to0.\] Here \(R_n^{\mathrm{or}}\) uses \(T_n^{\mathrm{full}}\), the learned action is evaluated on \(T_{n,m}^{\mathrm{main}}\), and \(B\) is induced by the common limit \(G_{\infty}\) and its continuous coarea boundary covariance. Moreover, the first term and the local minimax second term are jointly sharp among all pilot-measurable actions. This gives a second-order oracle-precision comparison on the explicitly narrower likelihood-rich subclass of Han and Deng's finite-population setting.
body.justification: The expansion exposes the two forces that determine pilot size below first order and supplies their sharp coefficients.
body.gap: Han and Deng prove consistency and first-order oracle precision but explicitly leave optimal learning-sample choice to refined asymptotics; no checked closer paper supplies these two coefficients.
body.consumer: It converts an informal learning fraction into a sample-size-dependent rule for repeated factorial production experiments.

obligation.what_is_open: The uniform second-order expansion and its matching arbitrary-action lower bound.
obligation.obstruction: Exact accounting isolates exactly two terms, but both coefficient-level asymptotics are unresolved: the oracle deletion term and the exact finite learned-action regret. Treating either as a hypothesis would violate the anti-laundering requirement.
obligation.attempted: Proved the exact decomposition and inserted the proposed coefficient expansions algebraically. This confirms there is no additional cross-wave term, while showing that the desired theorem is equivalent to the two unresolved uniform comparisons.
obligation.partial_result:
The exact accounting theorem proves the algebraic reduction
\[
R_{n,m}-R_n^{\mathrm{or}}
=\left\{d_{T_n^{\mathrm{full}}}-\left(\frac Nn\right)^2E d_{T_{n,m}^{\mathrm{main}}}\right\}
+\left(\frac Nn\right)^2E\{V_{T_{n,m}^{\mathrm{main}}}(\widehat G_m)-V_{T_{n,m}^{\mathrm{main}}}(G_{T_{n,m}^{\mathrm{main}}})\}.
\]
Thus the advertised expansion follows immediately once the first bracket is shown to equal \(A(\beta)m/n^2+o\{m/n^2+(nm)^{-1}\}\) uniformly and the second to equal \(B(\beta)/(nm)+o\{m/n^2+(nm)^{-1}\}\) uniformly.  Those are precisely the two unresolved finite comparisons; the exact identity introduces no third term.
